I collected my FISP coupon and got one bag of NPK fertilizer and hybrid seed for the household. I will put a small share on this 0.07 hectare plot — a few tins worth at each planting station — because the rest must go to my other land. I will also spread goat manure here since it is my own plot and manure costs nothing. My children and I will do all the work, about fifteen days from planting to harvest; I cannot pay for hired labor or chemicals when cash is tight.
